name: ModelRegistry catalog, selection, and policy methods

test_list.description: The built-in catalog contains exactly the six PLAN snapshot ids, records snapshot date 2026-10-20 with unknown live availability/capabilities and no invented price/context values, resolves aliases, and maps low through max as documented including xhigh reasoning.
Overlapping inclusive declarations use the first declaration, report overlap efforts, and uncovered efforts retain the configured base mapping.
A bad declaration rejects the whole update and preserves the previously active override layer.
Explicit metadata supports configured custom chat/vision/embedding models; catalog and alias bounds, malformed aliases, duplicate identities, and embedding effort targets are rejected.
Selection requires the effort and model allowlists and rejects explicitly unavailable choices while unknown availability remains selectable.
Unknown ids, duplicates, and stale timestamps reject the whole observation batch without partial mutation; fresh observations update availability and timestamp.
Cascade planning selects the configured lower-effort draft and requested verification choice and marks identical selections accurately.

inputs.name: registry
inputs.description: Explicitly configured model metadata and effort mappings.

inputs.name: observations
inputs.description: Provider observations to apply atomically with their observation timestamp.

output_description: A deterministic dated catalog and configured selection policy with explicit errors for invalid or disallowed inputs.
public_commentary: This contract describes only the dated repository snapshot and configured behavior. It does not claim live provider availability, current prices, token context limits, capability support, or cascade speedups.
